detail.longDescription: My local # AI can't read PDFs directly. So how do I feed it technical papers, diagrams, and specifications? I tested # PyMuPDF vs. # Docling for extracting text and images. Surprise: 294 MB vs. 6.2 GB (or 9 GB) installed! But Docling won my comparison. Methods, image proof sheets, and AI analyses: https:// salemdata.net/johnpress/?p=1310 # LocalAI # OpenSource # Python # LLM # SelfHosted
